headline: President Obama signed an order updating the Manual for Courts-Martial, the rulebook for military criminal trials.
what_it_does: This order makes the 2013 changes to the Manual for Courts-Martial. The manual sets the rules for how military criminal trials are run, including procedures and evidence. No summary was provided, so the specific changes are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the US armed forces
who_it_affects.how: Service members who face military criminal charges would have their cases handled under the updated trial rules.
Those who run and argue courts-martial must follow the amended procedures.
